resources.string:
For drawing boxes and arrows: an organisation, a loop, what feeds what.
## What it does
- Draws them at the phone's width, top to bottom or bottom to top
- Puts boxes inside a box, which becomes a group, one inside another, folded with a touch
- A box can link to a thing of the app, whose current name it shows, and open it
## Not made for
- A timeline (Agenda), a table (Records), figures (Chart)

## The schema
- Direction: top to bottom, or bottom to top

## Boxes
- Id: the short name arrows use
- Text: what the box says
- Link: a thing of the app, whose name the box shows when it has no text
- Shape, Icon, Color
- Fill: outline, its colour pale (the default), or full; Faded: for what is not there now
- Inside: the box that holds it; a box holding others is drawn as a group, its text as its title
- Starts folded: a group drawn as a box until touched

## Arrows
- From, To: two boxes, groups included, never a group and what it holds
- Text on the arrow, Line, Arrowhead

## Mermaid
- Import Mermaid: paste a flowchart; what it gives shows before it replaces the schema
- Copy as Mermaid: the schema as text, without its links

## The schema
Touch a linked box to open what it designates, a box whose text is cut to read it whole; a group's underlined title does the same.
Touch the rest of a group's title to fold or unfold it, for this visit: nothing is saved.
To change the schema, open its config.

A diagram in the vocabulary of Mermaid flowcharts, stored as JSON, never as Mermaid text; convert any Mermaid text you are given, a subgraph being a box that the boxes inside it name as their parent. Written for a phone held upright: direction TD or BT only, about ten boxes readable at a glance, short labels. When a box stands for a thing of the app, set its thing rather than a label, so that it follows its name. A box that holds others is drawn as a group, its label as its title; arrows join any two boxes, a group included, never a group and what it holds. Keeps no entries.
Boxes and arrows: an organisation, a loop, what feeds what

Whether what a box holds is read as parts stacked one under the other, in the order of the arrows, rather than as one drawing; an arrow from one part to the next is said by the order, any other between parts by a pair of letters
Whether the boxes at the top of the schema are read as parts stacked one under the other, in the order of the arrows, rather than as one drawing
The id of the box that holds this one, drawn as a group around it
Box “%1$s” is inside “%2$s”, which is not a box.
The arrow from “%1$s” to “%2$s” joins a group and what it holds.
Which way the arrows run: TD top to bottom, BT bottom to top; never sideways
One box, with a label, a thing, or both

Short id, unique among boxes, used by arrows and by the boxes inside it. Give one to a new box that an arrow or a box of the same write designates; omitted, the app makes one from its text. Repeat an existing box's id as it is: changing it cuts what designates it
The text shown; without it, the current name of its thing
The thing of the app it stands for and opens
Its shape, by its Mermaid 11 name
How the box is painted: outline, its colour pale under its border (the default), or full, a strong fill
Whether the box is drawn faded, for what is not there now: out of season, set aside
An icon name of the vocabulary (ICONS finds one), shown before the box's text; without one, a linked box shows its thing's icon
The id of the box it leaves
The id of the box it reaches
Whether it ends in a head; false for a plain line
Whether a box holding others opens folded, drawn as a box
This schema is empty. Add its boxes in its config, import a Mermaid text, or ask the AI.
Replaces the boxes and arrows of this schema. Nothing is stored until you save the config.

Line %1$d: “%2$s” is too long: %3$d characters at most.
Unknown direction “%1$s”: TD (top to bottom) or BT (bottom to top).
The id “%1$s” is used twice among the boxes.
Box “%1$s”: its link does not designate a thing of the app.
Box “%1$s” has neither a text nor a link.
An arrow lacks its start or its end.
